title: Vibration-based diagnostics of gear transmission systems: A review
journal: Journal of Machinery Manufacture and Reliability
abstract: Review of vibration analysis methods for gear transmission diagnostics including time-domain, frequency-domain, and time-frequency approaches.
notes: Comprehensive Russian-authored review in English; covers classical and modern approaches. No DOI available — citation via journal metadata.

title: Application of extended Kalman filter for real-time estimation of mechanical system parameters
conference: International Conference on Diagnostics of Machines and Structures
abstract: Proposes an EKF-based framework for real-time parameter estimation in rotating machinery. Validated on a laboratory test rig with simulated bearing faults.
notes: Conference paper; method applicable to drivetrain but tested on bearing system only. No DOI — cited by conference proceedings metadata.

title: Диагностирование технического состояния элементов трансмиссии мобильных машин на основе виброакустических сигналов
abstract: Разработаны методы и средства диагностирования элементов трансмиссии мобильных машин по виброакустическим сигналам. Предложена система классификации дефектов на основе нейронных сетей.
notes: Russian candidate of sciences dissertation. Directly relevant to drivetrain diagnostics domain. No DOI — accessed via library catalog.
